params.caption: 🎮 Chronicles: Medieval survives studio bankruptcy with $5M from Coffee Stain The developer of the historical strategy game Chronicles: Medieval filed for bankruptcy on the same day it revealed it was in trouble. The game is not dead: Coffee Stain is putting up $5 million, and a new studio led by key members of the original team will finish it. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 14:27 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 🙏 React if you're glad it's saved · 💬 Will you try it when it lands? #ChroniclesMedieval #CoffeeStain #StrategyGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
